query:
SELECT timestamp
              FROM meteora_damm_v2_swap_events
             WHERE pool_address = $1 AND timestamp >= $2
               AND timestamp <= COALESCE($3, 'infinity'::TIMESTAMPTZ)
               AND (timestamp < COALESCE($3, 'infinity'::TIMESTAMPTZ)
                    OR (signature, event_index) < ($4, $5))
             ORDER BY timestamp DESC
             OFFSET $6::BIGINT - 1
             LIMIT 1
